slug: 2025-11-19 Georeferencing of land titles - a revolution for security and transparency in Togo

facts.fact: The OTR says it is georeferencing land titles created before 2007, with surveyors measuring parcels and the data entered into a digital database, to modernise the cadastre; the Directorate of Cadastre and Land Conservation leads the operation.

systems.system: cadastre (digital database of georeferenced land titles)
systems.owner: Direction du Cadastre et de la Conservation Fonciere / OTR
